question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

'The rain fell heavy and caused flooding in the streets'.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the phrase **fell heavy**.
 
• In standard English, the word "heavy" is an adjective, and it cannot directly modify the verb "fell."
 
• To ensure grammatical correctness, the adverb "**heavily**" should be used instead of the adjective "heavy."
 
• The corrected phrase should be "**fell heavily**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The rain fell heavily and caused flooding in the streets."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in the streets"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "The rain"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "and caused flooding"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
